name: Mukhyamantri Matsya Sampada Yojana
benefit:
- Under this scheme, assistance is provided to small and large farmers/women engaged in various activities or items related to the fisheries sector, as mentioned in the table below**.**
**Activity/Item****Unit Cost****Grant (General Category)****Grant (Women / SC / ST)****Maximum Limit/ Grant Limit**Intensive Fish Farming₹4,000/- (per 1,000 fingerlings)50% of the cost price50% of the cost priceFor
_eligibility_text: 1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant should have availability of land and a water supply source or should already be engaged in fish farming. 1. All individuals/applicants belonging to any caste category in Uttarakhand are eligible to avail the benefits under this scheme.
